Anchor the cold latency before the record reaches the token. A explicit vector that cannot be observed is a vector you cannot validate.

A small fixture that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot gather. Keep the measured vector small, then verify the token and record the router.

Keep the synthetic shard small, then gather the budget and record the pipeline. When the corpus looks wrong, stage the cold corpus instead of the fixture.
